en.headline: Sixth Hong Kong International Food Fiesta opens today in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: The free five-day outdoor event at Cheung Sha Wan Playground runs until 30 November with a Sichuan food street and limited $10 lucky bags.
body: The Hong Kong Food Council is holding the sixth Hong Kong International Food Fiesta from today until 30 November at Cheung Sha Wan Playground.
Organisers said the outdoor carnival is free to enter and open daily from 10:30 am to 8 pm. The venue is next to Exit B of Cheung Sha Wan MTR station.

The event features a Sichuan food street, a global wine section, and stalls selling local and imported food products. Limited $10 lucky bags containing food items valued at over $100 are available, along with free popcorn and maltose at designated times, claw machines, and new sports game booths.

The council said the fiesta aims to help local food manufacturers promote products and support small and medium enterprises while giving the public opportunities to buy and sample food at preferential prices. All promotions and quantities are subject to the organisers’ final arrangements.

zh.headline: 第六屆香港國際美食巡禮今日長沙灣開幕
zh.dek: 香港食品委員會主辦的戶外嘉年華由今日起至30日於長沙灣遊樂場舉行，免費入場，設四川美食街及限量10元福袋。
body: 香港食品委員會今日起至11月30日在長沙灣遊樂場舉辦第六屆香港國際美食巡禮。
主辦方表示，活動免費入場，每日上午10時30分至晚上8時開放。場地鄰近港鐵長沙灣站B出口。
巡禮設有四川美食街、環球美酒展銷及售賣本地與進口食品的攤位。現場提供限量10元福袋，內含價值逾100元食品，並於指定時段派發爆谷及麥芽糖，另有夾公仔機及新興運動遊戲攤位。
委員會表示，活動旨在協助本港食品製造及相關企業推廣產品、支援中小企，並讓市民以優惠價錢購買及品嚐食品。所有優惠及數量以主辦單位最終安排為準。
